'''Rovi''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked as a guard at the [[High Card Casino]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Danteel]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Rovi secretly conspired to help the [[Casino/Legends|casino's]] business manager [[Darim Chumu]] to discredit [[Veilred Jydor]], the establishment's owner, and Rovi [[Death/Legends|murdered]] Jydor's rival [[Carisica Vanq]] and framed Jydor for the crime. A short time later, the [[Gambling/Legends|gambler]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] was overheard talking about Vanq in the casino, and Chumu sent Rovi to bring Calrissian to the manager's office.
